faq.question: What's included in the free version?
faq.answer: The free Starter Guide covers Chapters 1 and 2 — mindset, foundation, niche finding, and validation. Enter your email on the free download page to unlock the PDF instantly. You can also read a preview online without signing up.

faq.question: What's the difference between free and full?
faq.answer: The free Starter Guide (Chapters 1–2) helps you choose a direction and validate demand. The full e-book adds five more chapters on building your presence, offers, marketing, sales, and scaling — the complete launch playbook.

faq.question: Do I need technical skills?
faq.answer: No. The guide focuses on business fundamentals, tools anyone can use, and decisions that don't require coding. Technical readers will still find practical value in the systems chapter.

faq.question: What format is the e-book?
faq.answer: Both free and full versions are high-quality PDFs you can read on any device. The free guide is available instantly; the full guide is delivered after purchase.

faq.question: Is this only for Bangladesh?
faq.answer: The principles apply globally. Examples draw from real experience building online — relevant whether you're local or international.

faq.question: Can I get a refund on the full e-book?
faq.answer: If the full guide isn't what you expected, contact me within 7 days of purchase and I'll make it right.
